name: Send Google Calendar appointment reminder SMS with RCSZilla

parameters.content:
## n8n appointment reminder SMS

This workflow checks tomorrow's Google Calendar appointments, extracts a customer phone number and SMS consent from each event, then queues a reminder SMS through RCSZilla.

Use it for salons, clinics, consultants, auto service shops, real estate viewings, and other appointment-based businesses.

## Setup Guide

1. Install community node: n8n-nodes-rcszilla.
2. Create credentials for Google Calendar and RCSZilla.
3. In Google Calendar events, add appointment metadata to the description:

Name: Maria
Phone: +40700000000
SMS consent: yes

4. Keep the Schedule Trigger at 09:00 or change it to your preferred daily reminder time.
5. Choose the Google Calendar to scan.
6. Test with one internal event before activating.

Only send reminders to people who gave SMS consent.

## Event Format

The parser reads these fields from the calendar event title, description, and location.

Required in the description:

Phone: +40700000000
SMS consent: yes

Optional:

Name: Maria

The SMS includes the event summary, appointment date/time, location when available, and an opt-out line.

## Compliance Notes

This is a reminder workflow, not a bulk outreach workflow.

Keep SMS consent records in your booking process. Do not send to events that lack positive consent. Keep the opt-out text in the message: Reply STOP to opt out.

If your appointments involve sensitive data, keep the event summary and SMS wording generic.
